Supreme Court Upholds Karnataka HC Order on State Anthem Rendition

The Supreme Court has declined to interfere with a Karnataka High Court order that standardized the rendition of the Karnataka state anthem. The High Court had previously directed that the anthem, 'Jaya Bharata Jananiya Tanujate', be sung in a specific manner. The Supreme Court's decision means the Karnataka High Court's order on the anthem's standardized rendition will stand.
